name: Industry Radar — upstream-commit watcher
description: Per-commit watcher for upstream source repos: surfaces architectural decisions (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / breaking changes / refactors) Joseph's openclaw fork should react to. Heuristic relevance score over `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits` output; emits chuck.industry.radar.* bus events that apex-daily-digest folds into the morning Telegram summary. Salvages chuck-industry-radar.mjs.

sourcesPath.label: Sources config path
sourcesPath.help: JSON file with `repos: [{owner, repo, id, weight}]` describing the upstream surfaces to watch. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/workspace/state/chuck-v3/industry-radar/sources.json.

perRepoCap.label: Per-repo flagged-commit cap
perRepoCap.help: Max commits surfaced per repo per scan. Keeps the daily digest readable even on a noisy upstream.
